prompt:
Build a comprehensive, production-grade AI Creative Studio dashboard in static/ai_studio.html. Include:
1. UI/UX: Dark glassmorphism theme using HSL color tokens, vibrant indigo/cyan glowing accents, Google Inter typography, floating sidebar navigation, and subtle micro-animations.
2. Core Features:
   - Text Prompt Workspace with model selector dropdown (GPT-4, Claude 3, Llama 3) and temperature slider.
   - Live AI Output Console with instant markdown rendering, code syntax highlighting, copy-to-clipboard, and word/token counter metrics.
   - Media Assets Gallery with filter tabs (All, Images, Audio, Code) and lightbox preview modal.
   - System Status Footer displaying API latency (ms), active GPU memory usage %, and token usage gauge.
3. State & Persistence: Full JavaScript state management storing generated history items in LocalStorage.

issues.description: The code uses a lot of global variables, which can make it harder to maintain and debug. Consider using a more modular approach, such as using a class or a module to encapsulate the variables and functions.
issues.suggestion: Use a more modular approach, such as using a class or a module to encapsulate the variables and functions.

issues.description: The code does not handle errors properly, which can cause the application to crash or behave unexpectedly. Consider adding try-catch blocks to handle errors and provide a better user experience.

issues.description: The code uses the fetch API to make a POST request to the /api/generate endpoint, but it does not validate the response data properly.
